referral.merchant_message: Card declined at the till, the customer has left the card with us.

steps.text: I'll start by looking up the merchant, the transaction, and any earlier referrals — all in parallel.
The transaction was declined because the card is reported lost or stolen. Let me now verify the card status and run sanctions screening on the merchant and owner.

Here's a summary of my investigation:

| Check | Result |
|---|---|
| **Merchant** | Greenfield Garden Centre, owner Margaret Hale, trading 3,833 days, verified KYB |
| **Transaction** | £86.20 GBP, declined — "card reported lost or stolen" |
| **Card status** | Confirmed **lost_or_stolen** |
| **Sanctions (merchant)** | Score 0.29 — no concern |
| **Sanctions (owner)** | Score 0.44 — no concern |
| **Duplicate referral** | None |
| **Amount threshold** | Below £5,000 |
| **New-merchant risk** | N/A (trading 3,833 days) |

The card is confirmed as lost or stolen, so per policy this must be escalated to the **fraud** queue. The merchant also notes the customer left the card with them, which is an additional concern.
